meta.title: Software Factory
meta.description: Adds the /factory command: a managed 9-phase software-delivery pipeline (capture, plan, implement, review, guardrails, test, optional deploy, regression, evaluate) driven through DSH-native tools, with clarify-first grilling, a right-sidebar progress tab, a global worker queue observed in a left-sidebar panel in the Web client, and always-on git delivery — never asked about in interviews, and skipped whole only when the user explicitly declines — every run branches (gitflow name), commits in /draft-commit format, and pushes + opens a ready-for-review PR (/draft-pr format) onto a --base-selectable base (default main).
